target_profile.system_boundary: Captured Go raft package implementing replicated log, elections, configuration, snapshot recovery and client futures; caller supplies FSM, stores and transport. In-repository transports and stores remain in scope, not externalized merely because injected.

activities.purpose: Qualified support for decision formation and legal advancement
activities.realization_summary: Leader durable appends and per-peer support feed voter-majority commitment; followers accept consistent history and propagated commit indexes.

activities.purpose: Context validity and acquisition, transfer or loss of authority
activities.realization_summary: Term-based campaigns and persisted votes acquire authority; inbound terms, lease checks, transfer and role exit govern loss. Verification uses a separate notification tally.

activities.purpose: Recovery and resynchronization of eligible participation
activities.realization_summary: Startup reconstructs from log and snapshot; lagging replication installs a snapshot and resumes appends.
Logged configuration determines voter eligibility; latest and committed views support bounded configuration transition and rollback.
Committed entries queue to a serialized FSM owner; future completion follows application.

activities.purpose: History, persistence and reconstruction of support
activities.realization_summary: LogStore, StableStore and snapshot interfaces hold durable history and term/vote context; concrete store implementations remain to be reviewed.

activities.purpose: Client contracts, invocation intervals and observed completion
activities.realization_summary: Client APIs enqueue work and return futures; rejection, leadership loss and FSM completion have distinct meanings.

behaviors.execution_owner: Raft main loop and per-peer vote RPC goroutines
behaviors.protocol_context: Local term, latest configuration, log/snapshot tip
behaviors.trigger: Follower timeout, candidate retry, or TimeoutNow
implementation_guards: Only configured voters are solicited; majority is derived from latest voter count.
RequestVote checks term, candidate membership/suffrage where ID is supplied, existing leader, prior vote and log freshness; persists vote before granting.
Pre-vote does not persist or advance local term; successful pre-vote starts a real election.
writes: Real election persists incremented term and self vote; majority grants establish Leader state.
important_branches: Newer response term causes fallback; inbound append or higher-term vote may change role; timeout restarts campaign.
Leadership transfer bypasses pre-vote and permits vote despite known leader; flag resets when runCandidate returns.
async_boundaries: Each campaign has a fresh buffered response channel; old RPC replies remain on the old channel after candidate exit.

cross_activity_effects.A1: Chosen leader creates a new commitment context and begins with a no-op.

writes: Fresh commitment, replication map, inflight queue and verification set on entry.
external_effects: Dispatch initial no-op; lease loss or stale-term notification causes stepdown.
Exit closes replicator stop channels and responds ErrLeadershipLost to remaining inflight and verification futures.
async_boundaries: Each followerReplication retains the commitment and stepDown channel of its original tenure; late replies do not target newly allocated leader accounting.

cross_activity_effects.A1: startIndex is lastIndex+1 and prevents committing old-term support before a current-term entry is replicated.
cross_activity_effects.A7: Leadership loss is ambiguous for writes; it is not rollback of durable entries.

behaviors.protocol_context: Leader term and inflight log index
behaviors.trigger: Client apply batch, initial no-op, or configuration entry
writes: Assign sequential indexes and current term; enqueue futures; successful StoreLogs updates cached last log.
external_effects: Successful storage notifies each replicator; failure responds errors and sets Follower.
unknowns: appendConfigurationEntry continues updating configuration after dispatchLogs returns on storage failure; consequences and store fault contract need investigation.

behaviors.execution_owner: Per-peer replication and pipeline decoding goroutines
behaviors.protocol_context: Peer ID and captured leader term/commitment
behaviors.trigger: New-log trigger, periodic commit propagation, retry, pipeline result
implementation_guards: Successful AppendEntries response is required for match update; higher response term signals old leader stepdown.
writes: Success updates nextIndex and match at last request entry; rejection backs nextIndex down; missing log selects snapshot recovery.
async_boundaries: Transport response belongs to the issued request; pipeline responses expose Request and Response together.

cross_activity_effects.A3: Missing historical entries switches to InstallSnapshot; its success reports snapshot index match.

behaviors.execution_owner: Commitment mutex; leader main loop consumer
behaviors.protocol_context: Current leadership commitment and latest voter set
implementation_guards: Only voter IDs present in matchIndexes can advance their monotonic match index.
Sorted majority index must exceed current commitment and reach startIndex.
writes: Commitment advances and coalesces commitCh notification; leader consumes it into commitIndex.
external_effects: Leader queues committed inflight entries for FSM and marks configuration committed; removal of local vote triggers stepdown.

behaviors.execution_owner: Main RPC loop; heartbeat fast path has restricted empty requests
behaviors.protocol_context: Follower local term, stored prefix and leader commit index
implementation_guards: Older terms rejected; newer terms persisted and role changed; ordinary same-term append also steps down except transfer candidate.
Previous index/term must match; duplicate terms skipped; conflicting suffix deleted before replacement append.
writes: Successful replacement updates cached last log and latest configuration; conflict rolls latest configuration back to committed.
Leader commit propagation advances to min(leaderCommit,lastIndex) and queues unapplied logs.
important_branches: StoreLogs failure after successful DeleteRange returns failure without updating cached lastLog; explicit TODO recognizes this state.
Fast heartbeat requires zero previous index/term, no entries and zero leaderCommit at NetworkTransport classifier.

cross_activity_effects.A2: Append reception establishes leader contact and can invalidate candidate/leader authority.
cross_activity_effects.A4: Conflict truncation can discard an uncommitted configuration.

unknowns: Can cached tip survive a truncate/store failure and be consumed as if durable on a later legal append or vote?

behaviors.trigger: Configuration API request or configuration entry processing
implementation_guards: Leader admits a new change only when latest configuration is committed and a current-term entry is committed.
nextConfiguration checks prevIndex when nonzero and validates resulting configuration.
writes: Configuration entry immediately updates latest configuration, commitment voter membership and replication targets.
setConfiguration retains old match index for surviving voter IDs, defaults new voters to zero.

cross_activity_effects.A1: Voter set determines eligible matches and majority threshold.
cross_activity_effects.A2: Latest voter set determines campaigns, lease checks and leader removal.

behaviors.execution_owner: Construction thread before startup; RPC main loop and FSM restore goroutine for remote snapshot
implementation_guards: Startup loads term and log tip, restores a usable snapshot and scans subsequent log entries for configuration.
InstallSnapshot rejects old terms/version mismatch and size mismatch; waits on FSM restore future before reporting success.
writes: Restore sets lastApplied, lastSnapshot and both configuration views.
durable_effects: Received snapshot sink is finalized before FSM restore.

cross_activity_effects.A1: Snapshot provides prefix for lagging replicas; leader counts snapshot match after success.
cross_activity_effects.A2: Recovered log/snapshot tip is used in freshness checks; restored latest configuration determines eligibility.

unknowns: Ordering and freshness of delayed snapshots relative to already applied entries need separate legal-history analysis.

behaviors.protocol_context: Current term and last vote keys in injected StableStore
durable_effects: setCurrentTerm writes durable term before atomic memory state, panicking on error.
persistVote writes term key then candidate key; requestVote grants only if both succeed.

cross_activity_effects.A2: Durable vote tuple prevents multiple candidates being granted votes in the same term on normal successful storage paths.

unknowns: Partial two-key vote persistence failure/crash behavior and applicable storage error assumptions remain unexamined.

behaviors.execution_owner: Main processLogs producer; dedicated runFSM consumer
behaviors.protocol_context: Committed log index and FSM queue
behaviors.trigger: Commit processing or follower commit propagation
writes: processLogs ignores already queued indexes, queues commands/barriers/configurations as appropriate, then sets lastApplied.
runFSM serially invokes Apply or ApplyBatch and responds to matching futures after application; restore and snapshot requests share FSM owner.
async_boundaries: lastApplied records queueing by main loop, not necessarily completed application; future response is a separate endpoint.

cross_activity_effects.A7: Apply response and Barrier completion reflect FSM processing rather than just majority storage.

external_effects: Enqueue timeout is distinct from completion; followers and candidates reject leader operations.
VerifyLeader enqueues a verifyFuture; leader loop responds success when returned count reaches configured quorum.

cross_activity_effects.A2: VerifyLeader is publicly described as preventing stale reads after leadership loss.

behaviors.protocol_context: One verifyFuture within a leader tenure
writes: Sets votes=1 for self and quorumSize from latest voter count; one-voter case succeeds immediately.
Registers future in every replication state, including nonvoters, and triggers heartbeat.
unknowns: No suffrage filter is visible on registration despite voter-only quorum size.

behaviors.protocol_context: Registered verifyFuture and each replication notification map
writes: notifyAll swaps out per-peer pending map under notifyLock; vote(true) increments count under voteLock.
At threshold or first rejection, vote sends future to verifyCh and clears notifyCh; later votes ignored.
important_branches: Non-error heartbeat updates lastContact and votes response.Success without checking suffrage.
Transport errors supply no vote; replication higher term calls notifyAll(false) and signals stepdown.

behaviors.protocol_context: Completed tally for current tracked verifyFuture
behaviors.trigger: verifyCh returns future with nonzero quorumSize
external_effects: Count below quorum causes stepdown and ErrNotLeader; count at quorum produces nil error; pending per-peer notifications are cleaned.
unknowns: Whether the count can represent only self plus nonvoters in an admitted history, and thus fail the public authority-check responsibility.

behaviors.execution_owner: Leader loop with transfer goroutine; target main loop
implementation_guards: Default target is most advanced other voter; replication is brought through current tip before TimeoutNow.
external_effects: Leader loop restricts new writes during transfer; target enters Candidate with transfer flag; completion is coordinated with leader loop exit or timeout.
unknowns: Explicit-target eligibility and transfer cleanup under overlapping removal/shutdown need deeper investigation.

facts.meaning: For each tracked voter ID the current commitment object retains the highest index reported through its match interface; this accounting is used as durable prefix support, not independent verification of storage.
facts.validity_context: Current leader commitment object and configured voter membership; surviving voter values carry across setConfiguration.
facts.durability: Volatile; based on successful local storage, append response or snapshot response.
facts.recovery: Fresh leader commitment starts all voter matches at zero.

facts.meaning: The leader commitment object has advanced to an index supported by its voter-majority match calculation and at least its current-term startIndex.
facts.validity_context: Current leadership tenure and membership used for recalculation; monotonic within object.
facts.durability: Volatile derivation from stored replication support.
facts.recovery: New leadership rederives through a current-term no-op; startup restores snapshot and log history.

facts.meaning: A verifyFuture contains the initial self count plus positive notifications delivered through registered replication states before the first terminal notification. This is a notification count, not an assertion that counted peers are voters.
facts.validity_context: One verification registered during leader tenure, with quorumSize fixed at registration; notifyCh nil ends collection.
facts.recovery: No replay; pending tracked requests receive leadership-loss response on leader exit.

surfaces.entry_point: Raft.appendEntries truncation followed by StoreLogs failure
surfaces.reason: Failure return preserves stale cached lastLog after durable suffix removal. Need establish legal retry/election history and storage fault contract before an obligation.
Voter-derived threshold is fed by all registered replication peers; selected for next discriminator.
Distinct user restore history and pending-write abortion require deeper caller contract and resynchronization reading.
Classifier limits heartbeat mutation, but concurrent term/role ownership and shutdown dispatch deserve separate analysis.
Two-key persistence has an unresolved crash/error atomicity premise.

formation.explanation: A1: main-loop leader dispatch assigns index/term and stores entries, then local storage and successful per-peer append/snapshot replies report matches to a tenure-specific commitment. Only configured voter IDs enter the majority calculation; advancement must reach a current-term entry. The leader consumes commitCh and queues committed entries to FSM; ordinary AppendEntries carries commit index to followers, including periodic propagation when writes cease. Followers check previous log term, replace conflicts, and queue committed entries; runFSM responds after actual application.

context.explanation: A2: follower timeout starts a configured-voter campaign, with optional pre-vote, persistent real term/self vote and per-campaign response channel. RequestVote combines membership, term, durable vote and log freshness guards. A majority enters Leader, allocating fresh replication/commitment state and dispatching a no-op. Higher-term RPC/reply, failed voter contact lease, committed removal or transfer can end authority. Exit stops old replication and fails outstanding futures; old replies retain old channels/commitment. TimeoutNow starts a transfer campaign; the transfer flag resets at campaign exit.

connection.explanation: Previously stored entries survive role changes; new leaders rederive commitment under a fresh current-term barrier rather than inheriting match counts. Latest logged membership controls support eligibility, campaigns and lease quorum; leader configuration changes are serialized behind prior configuration commitment and current-term commitment, while follower truncation can restore committed membership. Startup loads term and log tip, restores snapshot/configuration and scans newer configuration entries; those histories constrain future votes and replication. VerifyLeader is a separate authority-consumption path: a voter-derived quorum threshold is compared with notifications from replication peers, an unresolved qualification discrepancy rather than a proved authority guarantee.

open_details: Selected verification count qualification question; lease and overlapping leader establishment are counterevidence/history premises.
Truncation/storage failure cache consistency; vote tuple partial persistence; snapshot freshness and user restore are retained leads.
Concrete storage/transport failure semantics, pipelined completion ownership and transfer edge cases need deeper source work.
core_overview.rationale: Representative formation, authority acquisition/loss, pending and old-work handling, membership, recovery and application are traced together. Usable navigation is not a completeness or correctness claim.
